entries.title: Arrows now join crewmates on different computers, and a review's arrow is orange
entries.body: When a crewmate waits on a task running on another computer, a gray arrow now points across to that task's crewmate, like every other wait. A crewmate reviewing another task now points at it with an orange arrow, the color of working crewmates, on the same computer or across to another one.

picture.alt: A crewmate on this computer with gray arrows to two crewmates on Studio Mac 1, and an orange arrow from a reviewer on Studio Mac 1 back to a crewmate on this computer
